kodaikanal.title: Kodaikanal • Poombarai • Mannavanur
kodaikanal.subtitle: Mist, Pine Forests & Serene Hillscapes
kodaikanal.overview: Escape to the Princess of Hill Stations. Experience tranquil lakes, misty pine forests, panoramic valley viewpoints, and the untouched rural charm of Poombarai village and Mannavanur lake.
highlights: Kodaikanal Star Lake Boating & Bryant Park
Coaker's Walk & Green Valley View
Pillar Rocks, Guna Caves & Pine Forest
Scenic drive to Poombarai Village & Murugan Temple
Mannavanur Sheep Farm & Eco-Lake
inclusions: 3 Nights accommodation in 3-star hill-view resort
Daily breakfast and dinner (CP/MAP plan)
Dedicated private cab (Sedan / SUV) with driver allowance, tolls, parking
Full sightseeing tours as per itinerary
24/7 tour concierge support
exclusions: Boating tickets, entry fees, and camera charges
Airfare / Train tickets to nearest hub (Madurai / Coimbatore)
Any personal expenses or optional activities

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kodaikanal & Lake Leisure
itinerary.desc: Welcome to the Princess of Hill Stations.
points: Pickup from Madurai / Dindigul / Kodai Road station or direct drive
Scenic ghat road drive to Kodaikanal; check-in at resort
Evening leisure walk along Kodaikanal Lake & Coaker's Walk
Overnight stay in Kodaikanal

itinerary.title: Iconic Sightseeing & Pine Forests
itinerary.desc: Explore Kodaikanal's most famous natural viewpoints.
points: Breakfast at resort
Visit Pillar Rocks, Guna Caves (Devil's Kitchen), and Moir Point
Walk through the towering Pine Forest and visit Green Valley View
Explore Bryant Park and evening shopping for homemade chocolates
Dinner and overnight in Kodaikanal

itinerary.title: Poombarai Village & Mannavanur Eco-Lake Excursion
itinerary.desc: Discover the pristine rural valleys beyond the main town.
points: Drive to picturesque Poombarai village with terrace farm views
Visit ancient Kuzhanthai Velappar Temple (Poombarai)
Proceed to Mannavanur sheep farm and tranquil eco-lake
Return to resort for relaxed dinner & bonfire
Overnight in Kodaikanal

itinerary.title: Silver Cascade Falls & Departure
itinerary.desc: Wrap up your hill getaway with sweet memories.
points: Breakfast and check-out from resort
Enroute photo stop at Silver Cascade Waterfall
Drop-off at Madurai / Dindigul station or onward travel destination

rajasthan.title: Jaipur • Udaipur • Jaisalmer
rajasthan.subtitle: Royalty, Forts & Golden Thar Desert
rajasthan.overview: Journey through the land of Maharajas. Marvel at the Pink City of Jaipur, the romantic lakeside palaces of Udaipur, and the golden sand dunes and living fort of Jaisalmer.
highlights: Amber Fort, City Palace & Hawa Mahal in Jaipur
Lake Pichola Sunset Boat Cruise & City Palace in Udaipur
Jaisalmer Golden Fort (Sonar Qila) & Patwon Ki Haveli
Sam Sand Dunes Camel Safari & Thar Desert Folk Night
Authentic Rajasthani Dal Baati Churma dining
inclusions: 5 Nights in heritage / 3-star luxury hotels & desert luxury tent
Daily buffet breakfast & dinner (including desert gala dinner)
AC Sedan / Innova for intercity transfers and all city tours
Camel safari & folk dance cultural performance at Sam Dunes
Driver allowances, state taxes, toll taxes, and parking
exclusions: Monument entry tickets, guide charges & camera fees
Airfare / Train tickets to Jaipur and from Jodhpur/Jaisalmer

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur (Pink City)
itinerary.desc: Welcome to the royal capital of Rajasthan.
points: Pickup from Jaipur Airport / Railway Station
Check-in at hotel; visit Albert Hall Museum & Birla Temple
Evening shopping at Johari & Bapu Bazaars
Overnight in Jaipur

itinerary.title: Jaipur Forts & Palaces Full-Day Tour
itinerary.desc: Explore the grandeur of Rajput architecture.
points: Visit majestic Amber Fort with elephant/jeep ride option
Photo stop at Jal Mahal (Water Palace)
Tour City Palace complex, Jantar Mantar (UNESCO site), and Hawa Mahal
Dinner & overnight in Jaipur

itinerary.title: Jaipur to Udaipur (City of Lakes)
itinerary.desc: Drive through scenic Aravalli hills to romantic Udaipur.
points: Breakfast & drive to Udaipur; enroute visit Chittorgarh Fort (optional)
Check-in at Udaipur hotel
Evening sunset boat ride on Lake Pichola with view of Jag Mandir
Overnight in Udaipur

itinerary.title: Udaipur Sightseeing & Drive to Jaisalmer
itinerary.desc: Palaces, gardens, and transit towards the Thar Desert.
points: Visit grand Udaipur City Palace & Saheliyon Ki Bari
Visit Jagdish Temple
Proceed towards Jaisalmer; check-in at hotel
Overnight in Jaisalmer

itinerary.title: Jaisalmer Fort & Sam Sand Dunes Experience
itinerary.desc: The Golden City and an unforgettable desert night under the stars.
points: Explore Jaisalmer Fort (Sonar Qila) and intricately carved Patwon Ki Haveli
Afternoon transfer to Sam Sand Dunes Luxury Desert Camp
Sunset camel safari & jeep dune bashing
Rajasthani folk music, Kalbeliya dance, bonfire & gala dinner
Overnight in luxury Swiss tent

itinerary.title: Departure from Jaisalmer / Jodhpur
itinerary.desc: Farewell to the royal desert land.
points: Breakfast at desert camp; visit Gadisar Lake
Transfer to Jaisalmer or Jodhpur Airport / Station for departure

tawang.title: Tawang • Dirang • Bomdila
tawang.subtitle: Monasteries, High Mountain Passes & Alpine Valleys
tawang.bestFor: Adventure Seekers • Mountain Enthusiasts • Offbeat Travelers
tawang.overview: Embark on an epic Himalayan expedition through western Arunachal Pradesh. Traverse the snow-capped Sela Pass (13,700 ft), visit India's largest monastery at Tawang, and witness roaring waterfalls.
highlights: Tawang Monastery (Galden Namgyal Lhatse) — India's largest
Sela Pass (13,700 ft) & frozen Sela Lake
Jung / Nuranang Waterfalls & Jaswant Garh War Memorial
Dirang Valley, Kiwi Orchards & Sangti Valley
Bomdila Monastery & scenic Himalayan panoramic viewpoints
inclusions: 5 Nights accommodation in cozy mountain lodges / 3-star hotels
Daily breakfast and dinner
Dedicated 4x4 / SUV vehicle with experienced hill driver
Inner Line Permit (ILP) assistance for Arunachal Pradesh
All toll, parking, driver allowance, and fuel charges
exclusions: Bum La Pass & Madhuri Lake special permit/local vehicle charges
Personal cold weather gear and tips

itinerary.title: Guwahati / Tezpur to Dirang Valley
itinerary.desc: Ascend into the lush green foothills of Arunachal Pradesh.
points: Pickup from Guwahati / Tezpur Airport/Station early morning
Drive past lush tea gardens to Bhalukpong (Arunachal border)
Proceed to Dirang; check-in at hotel
Visit Dirang Dzong (fort) and hot water springs
Overnight in Dirang

itinerary.title: Dirang to Tawang via Sela Pass (13,700 ft)
itinerary.desc: Crossing the legendary high-altitude pass into Tawang.
points: Breakfast and drive towards Tawang
Stop at breathtaking Sela Pass (13,700 ft) & Sela Lake
Visit Jaswant Garh War Memorial (1962 Indo-China War hero)
Marvel at the roaring Nuranang (Jung) Waterfalls
Arrive in Tawang and check-in; overnight in Tawang

itinerary.title: Tawang Monastery & Local Heritage
itinerary.desc: Immerse in Buddhist spirituality and local Monpa culture.
points: Visit 400-year-old Tawang Monastery — birth of Himalayan Buddhism
Visit Urgelling Monastery (Birthplace of 6th Dalai Lama)
Explore Tawang War Memorial & Light and Sound Show in the evening
Overnight in Tawang

itinerary.title: Tawang to Bomdila
itinerary.desc: Scenic return drive along rivers and valleys to apple capital Bomdila.
points: Breakfast & check-out from Tawang
Scenic drive through Dirang and Bomdila hills
Visit Upper & Lower Gompa (Monastery) in Bomdila
Evening stroll in Bomdila craft market
Overnight in Bomdila

itinerary.title: Bomdila to Tezpur / Bhalukpong
itinerary.desc: Descending back through pristine river gorges and forest reserves.
points: Breakfast and drive down towards Tezpur/Bhalukpong
Visit Tipi Orchidarium with over 500 orchid species
Relax along the Kameng River banks; overnight stay

itinerary.title: Return to Guwahati & Departure
itinerary.desc: Completion of an unforgettable Northeast journey.
points: Drive to Guwahati Airport / Railway Station for onward journey

singapore.title: Singapore City & Sentosa
singapore.subtitle: Futuristic Skylines & Island Fun
singapore.overview: Experience the world's most vibrant garden city. Explore futuristic supertrees, Marina Bay skyline, thrilling rides at Universal Studios, and the pristine beaches of Sentosa Island.
highlights: Gardens by the Bay — Flower Dome & Cloud Forest
Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck
Universal Studios Singapore (full-day pass)
Sentosa Cable Car Ride & Wings of Time Show
Singapore Night Safari (tram ride with live wildlife)
inclusions: 4 Nights in 4-star central city hotel (e.g. Orchard / Bugis / Marina area)
Daily international buffet breakfast
Airport transfers on private basis in luxury vehicle
All sightseeing & entry tickets mentioned in itinerary
Singapore e-Visa assistance & 24/7 tour coordination

itinerary.title: Arrival in Singapore & Night Safari
itinerary.desc: Welcome to the Lion City.
points: Arrival at Singapore Changi Airport (Jewel Changi Rain Vortex)
Private transfer to hotel; check-in and refresh
Evening visit to world's first Night Safari with tram ride
Overnight in Singapore

itinerary.title: Singapore City Tour & Gardens by the Bay
itinerary.desc: Iconic city monuments and the world's most futuristic botanical gardens.
points: Panoramic city drive: Merlion Park, Chinatown, Little India, Civic District
Ascend Marina Bay Sands SkyPark for 360-degree city views
Explore Gardens by the Bay: Cloud Forest, Flower Dome & Supertree Grove Light Show
Overnight in Singapore

itinerary.title: Universal Studios Singapore (Full Day)
itinerary.desc: Blockbuster movie rides and world-class entertainment on Sentosa.
points: Breakfast at hotel; transfer to Resorts World Sentosa
Full day at Universal Studios Singapore (Sci-Fi City, Ancient Egypt, Far Far Away)
Enjoy rides: Battlestar Galactica, Transformers 3D, Revenge of the Mummy
Return to hotel; overnight in Singapore

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island Highlights & Wings of Time
itinerary.desc: Cable cars, beaches, and spectacular waterfront fireworks.
points: Scenic Mount Faber Cable Car ride to Sentosa Island
Visit Madame Tussauds + Images of Singapore
Relax at Siloso / Palawan beach
Watch Wings of Time multi-sensory laser & water show
Overnight in Singapore

itinerary.title: Jewel Changi & Departure
itinerary.desc: Last-minute duty free shopping and departure.
points: Breakfast & check-out from hotel
Transfer to Changi Airport; explore Jewel Canopy Park & HSBC Rain Vortex
Board return flight home

vietnam.title: Vietnam Grand Explorer
vietnam.subtitle: Hanoi, Halong Bay Cruise, Da Nang & Ba Na Hills
vietnam.overview: From the limestone karsts of UNESCO World Heritage Halong Bay to the iconic Golden Bridge held by colossal stone hands in Ba Na Hills, experience the breathtaking beauty and rich culture of Vietnam.
highlights: Overnight Luxury Cruise on Halong Bay (Lan Ha Bay)
Golden Hand Bridge at Sun World Ba Na Hills
Hanoi French Quarter & Old Quarter Cyclo Tour
Lantern-lit ancient riverside town of Hoi An
Cu Chi Tunnels & Ho Chi Minh City landmark tour
inclusions: 6 Nights accommodation in 4-star/5-star hotels + 1 Night luxury cruise cabin
Daily buffet breakfast, all meals on cruise, and select local specialty meals
Domestic flights inside Vietnam (Hanoi - Da Nang - Ho Chi Minh)
All private guided tours and entrance fees
Vietnam single-entry tourist visa approval letter
exclusions: Gratuities/tips for local guides and drivers

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi — Capital of Culture
itinerary.desc: Welcome to Vietnam's charming colonial capital.
points: Pickup from Noi Bai International Airport; transfer to hotel
Check-in and evening walking tour of Hanoi Old Quarter & Hoan Kiem Lake
Traditional Vietnamese Water Puppet Show
Overnight in Hanoi

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Halong Bay (Overnight Luxury Cruise)
itinerary.desc: Cruising among thousands of emerald limestone islands.
points: Morning drive through Red River Delta to Halong Bay / Tuan Chau Marina
Board luxury cruise; welcome drink and gourmet lunch while cruising
Explore Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave and kayak through Luon Cave
Sunset party on sundeck, cooking demonstration & squid fishing
Overnight in luxury ocean-view cabin on cruise

itinerary.title: Halong Bay to Hanoi & Fly to Da Nang
itinerary.desc: Sunrise Tai Chi on bay and flight to central coastal Vietnam.
points: Sunrise Tai Chi session on sundeck; visit Ti Top Island for panoramic views
Brunch on board while cruising back to marina; disembark
Transfer to Hanoi airport for flight to Da Nang
Arrive in Da Nang; check-in at beachfront hotel & overnight

itinerary.title: Ba Na Hills & Iconic Golden Hand Bridge
itinerary.desc: Ride the world's longest single-track cable car into the clouds.
points: Full day tour to Sun World Ba Na Hills (1,487m above sea level)
Walk on the famous Golden Bridge held by gigantic stone hands
Explore French Village, Le Jardin D'Amour flower gardens & Fantasy Park
Buffet lunch at Ba Na Hills
Return to Da Nang; visit Dragon Bridge (fire show on weekends); overnight

itinerary.title: Hoi An Ancient Town Excursion
itinerary.desc: Step back in time in the UNESCO-listed lantern capital.
points: Afternoon drive to Hoi An Ancient Town
Visit Japanese Covered Bridge, Tan Ky Old House, and Phuc Kien Assembly Hall
Evening boat ride releasing flower lanterns on Hoai River
Overnight in Da Nang / Hoi An

itinerary.title: Fly to Ho Chi Minh City & Cu Chi Tunnels
itinerary.desc: Explore southern Vietnam's bustling metropolis.
points: Flight to Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon)
Half-day excursion to legendary underground Cu Chi Tunnels network
Saigon city landmarks: Notre Dame Cathedral, Central Post Office, Ben Thanh Market
Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

itinerary.title: Ho Chi Minh Departure
itinerary.desc: Farewell Vietnam with cherished memories.
points: Breakfast & check-out
Transfer to Tan Son Nhat Airport for onward flight

dubai.title: Dubai & Abu Dhabi Tour
dubai.subtitle: Futuristic Luxury & Arabian Desert
dubai.overview: Experience the glamour of Dubai — from the heights of Burj Khalifa and luxury Marina yacht cruises to exhilarating desert safaris and Abu Dhabi's Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.
highlights: Burj Khalifa 124th Floor View
Red Dunes Desert Safari & BBQ
Abu Dhabi Sheikh Zayed Mosque
Dubai Marina Dhow Cruise Dinner
Dubai Miracle Garden / Frame
inclusions: 5 Nights in 4-Star / 5-Star City Hotel
Daily international buffet breakfast
Desert Safari with 4x4 Dune Bashing, Camel Ride, Tanoura & BBQ Dinner
Marina Dhow Cruise with 5-Star buffet dinner & live entertainment
Burj Khalifa 124th Floor observation deck tickets with Dubai Mall fountain show
Full-day Abu Dhabi city tour with Grand Mosque
UAE Tourist Visa and travel insurance assistance
exclusions: International airfare and Tourism Dirham Fee
Optional tickets: Museum of the Future, Ferrari World, Aquaventure

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai & Marina Dhow Cruise
itinerary.desc: Welcome to the City of Gold.
points: Airport pickup in private vehicle
Hotel check-in & relax
Evening luxury Dubai Marina Dhow Cruise with dinner
Overnight in Dubai

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour & Burj Khalifa
itinerary.desc: Contrast of historic heritage and futuristic wonders.
points: Visit Dubai Frame, Palm Jumeirah & Atlantis photo stop
Explore Dubai Mall & Dubai Aquarium (exterior)
Ascend Burj Khalifa 124th Floor for skyline views
Watch Dubai Fountain Show
Overnight in Dubai

itinerary.title: Dubai Miracle Garden & Red Dunes Desert Safari
itinerary.desc: World's largest flower garden followed by thrilling desert dunes.
points: Morning visit to Dubai Miracle Garden (seasonal)
Afternoon 4x4 desert safari pickup
Dune bashing, sandboarding, and camel rides
Bedouin camp BBQ dinner with belly dance & fire show
Overnight in Dubai

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi Grand Mosque & City Tour
itinerary.desc: The majestic capital of the Emirates.
points: Drive to Abu Dhabi via Sheikh Zayed Road
Tour magnificent Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
Drive along Abu Dhabi Corniche & Emirates Palace photo stop
Photo stop at Ferrari World Yas Island
Return to Dubai for overnight stay

itinerary.title: Gold Souk, Museum of Future & Shopping
itinerary.desc: Bustling traditional bazaars and architectural marvels.
points: Explore historic Deira Gold & Spice Souks
Abra water taxi ride across Dubai Creek
Photo stop at Museum of the Future
Shopping at Mall of the Emirates
Overnight in Dubai

itinerary.title: Dubai Departure
itinerary.desc: Final souvenir collection and airport transfer.
points: Breakfast & check-out
Transfer to Dubai International Airport for departure
